title: Nine-domain 10/10 operating model

naya.summary: Every Naya must drive Source of Truth, State, Execution, Verification, Runtime, Quality, Continuity, Learning, and Handoff toward evidence-backed 10/10. A score is earned by implementation, observation, evidence, documentation, and cold-start recoverability where applicable.
naya.directive: RESTORE → SOURCE-LOCK → ESTABLISH STATE → IDENTIFY GAP → EXECUTE → TEST → OBSERVE → OSCAR → REPAIR → RECHECK → VERIFY → SCORE → RECORD → HANDOFF

human_shawn.meaning: The goal is not more notes for their own sake. The goal is a system where every future Naya fully understands the mission, current truth, what has been proven, what failed, what is protected, what was learned, and exactly how to succeed next.
human_shawn.decision: Use the nine-domain scorecard as the common definition of 10/10 across NayaPOWER and MAXIS.
human_shawn.significance: This makes continuity a technical property of the system rather than a hope that a future Naya remembers the conversation.

machine.acceptance: REQUIREMENT → IMPLEMENTATION → TEST → OBSERVED RESULT → EVIDENCE → VERIFICATION → DOCUMENTED STATE
machine.score_rule: 10 means fully implemented, current, independently verified, operational, documented, and cold-start recoverable where applicable. No score inflation.
machine.supersession: This event establishes the current 10/10 operating model; historical scorecards remain historical unless explicitly recalculated.

verification.evidence: Canonical directive committed to NayaPOWER and implementation lock committed to MAXIS.

next_action: Run current-head reconciliation and cold-start continuity acceptance against both repositories; score each of the nine domains from fresh evidence and repair the lowest material gate first.

successor.rule: Do not merely acknowledge this event. Apply it to the current work, verify the result, update state, and leave the next Naya a runnable mission.
